# `cube::Creature`

[Game reference](../README.md) › [creatures](../creatures.md) › `cube::Creature`

- **Kind:** class, 0x1E60 bytes
- **Status:** verified (source: kyubu)
- **C:** `cube_Creature` in `cubeworld/types.h`
- **Lua:** `cubeworld.cast("cube_Creature", address)`
- **Evidence:** `probe:creature-collection`, `manual:operator new(0x1E60) before each constructor call`
- **Confirmed by:** [creature-collection](../probes.md#creature-collection)

the same size in both builds. Its RTTI vtable is at +0, its id at +8 and cuwo's creature data at +0x10 (8.1); after +0x1178 only the ability limits of 9.4 are mapped (stamina, ability_cooldowns, spent_mp)
